name: @amzn/aplus-content-manager
description: Sample solution: manage Standard and Premium A+ Content with the Selling Partner API, with an approximate product detail page preview.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
